name: output_kind

question.instructions: What kind of output did this coding-agent tool call return?

criteria.test_results: the report of a test run (test names, pass/fail counts), whether the tests passed or failed
criteria.file_contents: the contents of a file as read from disk (source code, config, docs, data)
criteria.error_message: an error the tool or command itself raised (stack trace, command not found, permission denied), not a test report
criteria.search_results: hits from a search (grep/ripgrep/find/code or web search) listing matches and their locations
criteria.command_output: any other output of a shell command or program (build logs, git status, ls, installs, scripts)

notes: topic_kind: the kind of output is a global, topical property of the text. Predicted: both understudents graduate quickly (hunch's own pi-stream replay graduated output_kind at item 149).
